title: Welcome: How Every Day Works
about: Know the daily loop, what counts as a daily workout, and why today's baseline matters.
action: Do your baseline tester and take private before photos (front, side and back).
bonus: Baseline: tester workout + private before photos (members: book an InBody scan this week)

title: Your Plan, Your Rules
about: Know exactly what earns a nutrition yes on your plan and the rules every plan shares.
action: Plan tomorrow's breakfast, lunch, dinner and one snack from your plan's food list.
bonus: Kitchen reset: box up the off-plan foods

title: The Stress Bucket
about: Understand that life and training stress fill one bucket, so food, alcohol, sleep and water decide whether training builds you up or breaks you down.
action: Tonight, turn screens off 30 minutes before bed and pick a lights-out time.
bonus: Send your coach your #1 goal and biggest obstacle

title: Hydration: Your Daily Target
about: Know your water target, why it matters, and how to get through the early-week dip.
action: Fill a measured bottle and finish half your target by lunch and the rest by 5 PM.
bonus: Introduce yourself to your team: name, goal and one fun fact

title: Weekend Game Plan: Is It Worth It?
about: Plan your first weekend on the plan ahead of time and know how to bounce back from a slip without guilt.
action: Plan the weekend now: the events, what you’ll order, and your first on-plan meal afterward.

title: Train Smart: Workouts and Extras
about: Know what earns a yes on the daily workout and on each extra you chose, and how to scale around pain or no gym.
action: Put next week's workouts and extras on your calendar.
bonus: Film a 30-second starting clip of your skill or mobility test (re-filmed Days 29 and 41)

title: Sleep: Your Recovery Multiplier
about: Know why sleep drives every goal, what counts as a Sleep yes, and the habits that matter most.
action: Set one wake time for the week and a phones-down alarm 45 minutes before bed.
bonus: Week 1 check-in: share one win with your team or coach

title: Build Your Plate by Hand
about: You can size every meal for your goal without a scale or app.
action: Build dinner by hand tonight: a palm of protein, a fist of veggies, a cupped hand of carbs, a thumb of fat.

title: Protein First: Your Target and 7 Rules
about: Know your daily protein target and the habits that get you there.
action: Work out your protein target (about 0.7–1 g per pound of goal bodyweight) and eat a palm of protein first at every meal today.

title: Wig Wednesday: Week 1 Standings
about: See where your team stands, celebrate week-1 wins across every goal, and pick up one quick tip.
action: Send your team captain one win from your week for next week’s shout-outs.

title: Crush Cravings
about: You can tell hunger from a craving, know your plan's sweetener rule, and have a plan for your most common craving.
action: Write down your most common craving and an if-then plan for it.

title: Weekend Game Plan: Eating Out
about: You can stay on plan at restaurants, parties and playoff watch parties without feeling like the odd one out.
action: Look up the menu for your next meal out and choose your order now.
bonus: Send a question for Sunday’s Ask the Coaches

title: Gut Check
about: Know what healthy digestion looks like and how to help your gut adjust to the new plan.
action: Add one fermented food or an extra serving of vegetables today.

title: Ask the Coaches #1
about: Get quick answers to the group's top early questions and choose one thing to tighten for week 3.
action: Pick one thing to tighten up for week 3.
bonus: Week 2 check-in: share one win with your team or coach

title: Beat the Week-3 Slump
about: Expect the week-3 dip and have a minimum plan, sick days included, that keeps you consistent.
action: Write the “minimum version” of each item on your checklist for tough days.
bonus: Rewrite your Other habit (or most-missed item) as an if-then plan

title: Carbs 101: Find Your Best Carbs
about: Understand how different carbs affect energy and hunger and start a short self-experiment.
action: Start the carb experiment: notice how tonight’s carbs affect your energy and hunger.

title: Wig Wednesday: Week 2 Standings
about: Keep team energy up through the toughest week.
action: Message a teammate who has gone quiet and invite them to a workout or check-in.

title: Hormones: Work With Your Body
about: Understand how hormones shape hunger, energy, recovery and the scale, and pick one adjustment for your life stage.
action: Watch your version and choose one adjustment for the next 7 days.

title: Weekend Game Plan: One Meal, Two Ways
about: You can feed a partner and kids who aren't on the plan without cooking twice.
action: Plan one build-your-own family meal for this weekend.

title: Fuel Your Workouts
about: You can time and size food around training for your goal without stressing over the exact minute.
action: Plan the meal before and the meal after your next hard session.
bonus: Add a favorite plan-friendly recipe to the Koda Cookbook

title: Halfway: Progress Beyond the Scale
about: Judge your progress fairly and choose one adjustment for the second half with your coach.
action: Do your 10-minute halfway check-in with your coach (in person, video or phone).

title: Beat Food Boredom
about: Refresh your meals with a one-hour weekly prep and the Koda Cookbook.
action: Pick two new cookbook recipes and add their ingredients to your grocery list.

title: Fats and Oils: What to Cook With
about: Know a sensible daily fat amount, why every plan drops seed oils, and what to cook with instead.
action: Check your pantry oils and swap any on the avoid list.

title: Wig Wednesday: Halfway Standings
about: Celebrate halfway wins and keep the rivalry going into the long weekend.
action: Share one non-scale win with your team.
bonus: Suggest a topic for a future video

title: Recovery Tools and Deloads
about: Know which recovery tools are worth your time and how to tell normal soreness from under-recovery.
action: Swap one hard session this week for a 30-60 minute easy outdoor session.

title: Three-Day Weekend: Valentine's, Game Day, Travel
about: Have a plan for a big social, travel-heavy three-day weekend and bounce right back afterward.
action: Write down your weekend plan: what you’ll eat and drink, and your first on-plan meal afterward.
bonus: Share one on-plan game-day or date-night idea with your team

title: Spend Smart
about: Put grocery money where quality matters most and save where it doesn't.
action: Add one quality upgrade and one budget swap to your grocery list.

title: Ask the Coaches #2
about: Clear up mid-challenge questions and set up week 5.
action: Complete your week 4 check-in and choose one upgrade for week 5.
bonus: Week 4 check-in: share one win with your team or coach

title: Level Up Your Extras
about: Measure progress on your extras and push them through the last two weeks.
action: Re-film your skill or mobility clip and set a target for Day 41.

title: Supplements: Last, Not First
about: Know the few supplements worth considering once sleep, food and water are in place, and how to choose them safely.
action: Check each supplement you take against today's list and your plan's rules.

title: Wig Wednesday: Week 4 Standings
about: Bounce back from the long weekend and build momentum into the final stretch.
action: Cheer on a teammate who’s had a tough week.

title: HRV: Read Your Recovery
about: You can read your recovery with or without a wearable and match training intensity to it.
action: Rate your readiness 1–5 this morning (or check your HRV) and match today’s workout to it.

title: Weekend Game Plan: Zone 2
about: Know why easy, talking-pace work counts and how to fuel it.
action: Schedule one 30-60 minute outdoor zone 2 session this weekend.

title: Breathe Better
about: You can use nasal and box breathing to lower stress, sleep better and recover between efforts.
action: Do 3–5 minutes of box breathing tonight.

title: Final-Week Game Plan
about: Set up a strong, fair finish.
action: Set your 7-for-7 goal for the final week.
bonus: Book your retest (members: grab an InBody slot)

title: Consistency Beats Intensity
about: Shift from six perfect weeks to habits you can keep at 80% all year.
action: Write down the three habits that gave you the most.

title: Reintroduction: Test, Don't Guess
about: Know how to bring removed foods back one at a time to learn what your body tolerates.
action: Choose the first food you'll bring back and put its dates on your calendar.
bonus: Share the three habits you’ll keep with your team

title: Wig Wednesday: Last Call
about: See the standings going into the final days and rally for the finish.
action: Tell your team your 7-for-7 finish goal.

title: Eating for Maintenance
about: Know how to keep, or keep building, your results after Day 42, based on your goal.
action: Decide how often you’ll spot-check your habits after the challenge (weekly or monthly).

title: Build Your Playbook
about: Turn six weeks of lessons and your own data into a one-page plan you can run on your own, and prepare for a fair retest.
action: Write your one-page Resolutions Playbook: your habits, your go-to meals and your plan for slips.

title: Retest Day
about: Retest fairly and read your results beyond the scale.
action: Do your retest and take your after photos.
bonus: Retest: tester, after photos (members: InBody) and a re-filmed skill or mobility clip

title: Finish Line: Keep Going
about: Celebrate, choose your path forward, and set reminders that keep you going.
action: Set a phone reminder four weeks from now to check in on your habits.
